channel.title: Vice City Hub - The Wire
channel.description: The GTA VI fan hub: live news, Leonida intel, GTA RP servers, Web3 domains and merch — open to humans and AI agents.

item.title: GTA 6 Will Be Eligible for The Game Awards 2026
item.description: Cutting it close, Rockstar, but the trophy cabinet is open.

item.title: CYBERLEEK Says He's Done Leaking GTA 6 'For Now' After One More Unofficial Clip
item.description: The leaker is taking a break. Sure, and Rockstar is taking a nap.

item.title: GTA 6-Themed Cars, Including a Vice Beach Police Lamborghini, Cruise Through Miami
item.description: A Lamborghini cop car in Miami. Reality finally caught up to the trailers.

item.title: Miami-Dade Commissioners Question Rockstar's $975,000 Rooftop Ad Deal for GTA 6
item.description: Even county commissioners want a piece of Vice City. Wanted level: paperwork.

item.title: Rockstar Reportedly Asked Daft Punk to Reunite for GTA 6 Before Landing on Justice
item.description: Robots stay retired, Justice gets the gig. Unconfirmed, but sounds expensive.

item.title: Rockstar Spent Years Testing Alternatives to GTA 6's Weapon Wheel Before Going Back to the Circle
item.description: Years of R&D to reinvent the wheel. Turns out the wheel was fine.

item.title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Are 148% Ahead of Modern Warfare 2, Sensor Tower Data Suggests
item.description: Pre-orders crush a Call of Duty. Wallets have left the building.

item.title: Rockstar Bosses Tell Bloomberg There Won't Be Another Eight-Year Wait After GTA 6
item.description: Rockstar promises the next game won't take eight years. Bold words from the studio that invented 'soon'.

item.title: Rockstar Drops the GTA 6 Launch Trailer: Jason and Lucia, a Justice Score and a November 19 Date
item.description: A month out, Rockstar finally shows the plot: easy score, bad idea, hotel pool. Textbook Vice City.

item.title: Leaker CYBERLEEK Threatens a Full GTA 6 Build Drop Unless Rockstar Reverses Its Disc Decision
item.description: A demand letter from the internet's loudest hostage-taker. Unconfirmed, and your popcorn is optional.

item.title: Australia's Workplace Watchdog Publishes a Guide to Taking Unpaid Leave for GTA 6 Launch Day
item.description: Even the government wants you to ask nicely before ghosting your shift.

item.title: Nintendo of America Boss Dodges the GTA 6 Switch 2 Question
item.description: Not a yes, not a no. Corporate politician mode: activated.

item.title: Xbox Exec Says No Exclusive Cloud Streaming Deal for GTA 6 - And No PC Streaming Either
item.description: No secret cloud deal, no PC streaming. The potato-powered Vice City dream stays on life support.

item.title: Boxed GTA 6 Is Already Selling Out: Code-in-Box Edition Gone at Amazon US and Some Target Stores
item.description: A box with a download code in it, and people still stampeded. Retail is thriving on pure FOMO.

item.title: Rockstar Reveals GTA 6 Radio Lineup: Six Stations, Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Slayer Alumni
item.description: Six stations, zero excuses for a bad road trip. Even your getaway driver gets a playlist.

item.title: The Man Who Leaked GTA 6 Is Heading to Trial the Same Month It Finally Launches
item.description: Talk about a plot twist Rockstar didn't write. The hacker who leaked GTA6 to the world in 2022 goes to trial in November - the exact same month the game finally ships.

item.title: Rockstar Says GTA 6's Cops Will Be Much Harder to Shake Than GTA 5's
item.description: No more casually driving three blocks and calling it even. Rockstar North's telling you straight: the police are done playing around.

item.title: GTA 6 Pre-Loading Opens November 12 - A Full Week Before Launch
item.description: Clear your hard drive now. A full week of pre-load buffer means zero excuse to be downloading at midnight on launch day.

item.title: GTA 6 Has a Real Relationship System Between Jason and Lucia - But Rockstar Says Don't Overhype It
item.description: It's there, it's real, and Rockstar's already telling you to temper expectations. Bonnie and Clyde, but managed by PR.

item.title: GTA 6 Just Confirmed Its First Officially Revealed Cast Member
item.description: One name, one character, and suddenly the voice cast rumor mill has an actual confirmed data point to argue over.

item.title: Sony Just Showed Off a Limited-Edition GTA 6 DualSense Controller
item.description: Your thumbs deserve to match the game. Sony's put out a Vice City-themed controller, and it's PlayStation Direct only.

item.title: Take-Two Just Signed a New Long-Term Xbox Deal - But It Won't Change Anything About GTA 6
item.description: Big headline, small story. Lawyers renewed a contract, and somehow the internet decided this meant something about GTA6 and Xbox.

item.title: Rockstar's Official Goodtime State Vice City Collection Just Dropped
item.description: Straight from the source this time, not a knockoff. Rockstar's own merch line finally has a Vice City collection, and it's limited.

item.title: New Rockstar Character Art Is Already Showing Up in a Spotify Ad Collaboration
item.description: The billboards are already up. Rockstar's key art just got a co-branding partner, and it's not who you'd expect for a crime game.

item.title: GTA 6 Is Officially Rated Mature - And Its Store Listing Specifically Flags 'Sex Scenes'
item.description: GTA 5's rating just said 'sex.' GTA 6's says 'sex scenes,' specifically. Somebody in Rockstar's writers room clearly had a moment.

item.title: GTA 6's Game Informer Cover Story Confirms a Map Twice the Size of GTA 5 - And Over 170 Animal Species
item.description: Fourteen pages, twelve screenshots, and a whole ecosystem. Rockstar just confirmed Leonida has more wildlife than most actual nature documentaries.
